nodes.label: SharkFin Brand Identity (finance/trading)
nodes.rationale: Shark fin cutting through blue waves evokes a predatory, market-savvy investor; the 'i' in Fin is replaced by a red zig-zag rising price line with a green square dot, tying the brand to stock trading (red/green = down/up).

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Rules
